Hi friends, happy Thursday!

I love Wendy Williams. She’s an icon, she’s a legend, and “she is the moment.” From 2008 to 2021 Wendy hosted over 2,000 episodes of her show, got an Emmy nomination for best host, and honestly gave us some of the best memes and clips of all time. 

Then, in 2021, Wendy kind of… Vanished. No one really said what was going on. Just that she was dealing with “health problems.”

Turns out, Wendy was put under something called… a“conservatorship.”

Now this was allegedly to help her manage her life and money in this difficult time. But a lot of fans, myself included, were left wondering… who’s really calling the shots here? And is Wendy in trouble? 

It seems like we only hear about conservatorships when it comes to celebrities. But after I did some digging… it turns out, it’s *WAY* more common than we think. So let’s get into it.

I appreciate you for coming by, and tune in next week for more Dark History.

I was myself in an abusive conservatorship so I already know I can't watch this without getting triggered, but I had to comment.
I can't say strongly enough "if it can happen to someone like Britney, it can happen to any of us" - and it does! There are tons of people in your community right now who does not have autonomy in some aspect of their life.

Like Britney, I did need help at the start of my conservatorship too. I had suffered a severe brain injury and couldn't stay conscious enough to safely care for myself. 10 years later, there are still some areas in where I am totally dependent on another. As I recovered function, though, the conservatorship tightened to the point where I wasn't allowed to refuse even medical experiments at the research hospital. They had total control over every aspect of my life. 

Unlike Britney, I didn't have a chance to touch so many lives and earn their support when the conservator abused his power. I ended up being unable to fully recover as a result of the experiments and the conservator embezzled all my money which left me homeless. I am now fully liberated and in a country where the rights of disabled people will not allow this to happen again. I am not being adequately supported but I know where I'll sleep every night and my bank card is securely in MY purse. I just would like treatment and accommodation for what still lingers after the abuses. I'm still not living the full life I could be with symptom management.

Hey as far as Conservatorships, i thought I’d share a bit of practical background since you asked, So, I work in healthcare and in my position I am well versed on conservatorships.  When a person no longer has the capability to make sound decisions, due to cognitive impairments, memory loss, etc. they may select a Power of Attorney, to handle their finances and/or health.  This is typically a trusted family member or friend.  But sometimes people don’t have anyone to act as POA so they may request a Guardian or conservator which often is also an attorney to handle their personal affairs while they are unable to care for themselves.
